beaches.name: Lagada (Langada / Eftyhia), Makrigialos
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported along most of the beach, with the western end most used. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2001 to 2023, one in 2016 describing a large informal 'Nude Friendly Beach' sign at the west end; a Cretan beach guide says part of the beach is preferred by nudists and a 2021 German directory entry lists it as a nudist beach. No authority designation is documented.

beaches.name: Chrissi (Gaidouronisi) island
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported west of Golden Beach and in south-east coves. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2000 to 2014 at Shell Beach and beyond the northern headland, one noting a local scolding a nude bather; a 2012 Cretan magazine entry answers 'nudism: yes'. A ministerial decision published 22 May 2026 limits visitors to delimited beaches and landings to designated piers; whether the reported spots remain reachable is not documented.

beaches.name: Diaskari, Makrigialos
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported at the eastern end and in a small cove beyond the rocks. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 1997 to 2016 with mixed findings; the May 2016 report notes local acceptance of that end, the September 2016 report found only clothed bathers. No report is newer than 2016 and no designation or signage is documented.
